judgement.reason: Paperless-ngx is a Django web app on PostgreSQL and Redis whose s6 supervisor and local media storage are contained changes (separate worker, S3 storage).

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: Dockerfile runs s6-overlay with 20 long-running services (init-compile-bytecode, init-complete, init-custom-init, init-env-file) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile installs s6-overlay and copies its service definitions into the image, and no shown line proves that the production app runs as only one web process.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /usr/src/paperless/data (Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The shown lines do not prove that the data directory in the volume holds only replaceable or cache data, so the finding needs vendor confirmation.
